ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (TA505/FIN11/GRACEFUL SPIDER) LEMURLOOT 'human2.aspx' web shell drop on MOVEit Transfer / GoAnywhere MFT
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Cl0p mass-MFT-exploitation chain (CVE-2023-34362 MOVEit, CVE-2023-0669 GoAnywhere, CVE-2024-50623 Cleo): drop of the LEMURLOOT .aspx web shell into the MOVEit Transfer/DMZ wwwroot followed within an hour by w3wp.exe spawning hands-on-keyboard recon binaries. This file/path/parent triple is uniquely tied to Cl0p's 2023-2024 zero-day campaigns and is not seen during normal MOVEit operation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified","renamed") AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitDMZ\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\GoAnywhere\\tomcat\\webapps\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" AND NOT Filesystem.file_name IN ("human.aspx","login.aspx","guestaccess.aspx","machine.aspx","default.aspx","authentication.aspx","error.aspx","err.aspx") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_guid Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | join type=outer dest [ | tstats `summariesonly` count as iis_child_count values(Processes.process_name) as iis_children values(Processes.process) as iis_child_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Processes.parent_process="*MOVEitDMZ*" OR Processes.parent_process="*MOVEitTransfer*" OR Processes.parent_process="*GoAnywhere*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ]
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let MoveitNoise = dynamic(["human.aspx","login.aspx","guestaccess.aspx","machine.aspx","default.aspx","authentication.aspx","error.aspx","err.aspx"]);
let WebShellDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot", @"MOVEitDMZ\Public", @"GoAnywhere\tomcat\webapps")
    | where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".aspx.lnk" or FileName endswith ".jsp"
    | where FileName !in~ (MoveitNoise)
    | project DropTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let IISHandsOn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer","GoAnywhere")
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, ChildImage=FileName, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, ChildAccount=AccountName;
WebShellDrops
| join kind=leftouter IISHandsOn on DeviceId
| where isnull(ChildTime) or abs(datetime_diff('minute', DropTime, ChildTime)) <= 60   // pair drop with w3wp child within 1h
| project DropTime, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          ChildTime, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildAccount
| order by DropTime desc

          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername,
          ChildTime, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildAccount
| order by DropTime desc

title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT Web Shell Drop in MOVEit Transfer / GoAnywhere MFT wwwroot
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of an .aspx/.jsp file that is not one of the shipped MOVEit/GoAnywhere artefacts inside the MFT wwwroot. Signature of Cl0p's LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) post-exploit web shell.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/lemurloot-clop-moveit-transfer
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/06
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEitDMZ\Public\'
      - '\GoAnywhere\tomcat\webapps\'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.aspx.lnk'
      - '.jsp'
  filter_shipped:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\human.aspx'
      - '\login.aspx'
      - '\guestaccess.aspx'
      - '\machine.aspx'
      - '\default.aspx'
      - '\authentication.aspx'
      - '\error.aspx'
      - '\err.aspx'
  condition: selection_path and selection_ext and not filter_shipped
falsepositives:
  - Vendor-authorised hotfix that adds a new aspx file to the MOVEit/GoAnywhere wwwroot (verify against Progress / Fortra release notes)
level: high

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p ransomware impact chain: shadow-copy + recovery destruction co-occurring with .clop encryption fan-out and 'CIopReadMe.txt' note drops
ucs.description: Hunts the Cl0p (TA505 / FIN11 / GRACEFUL SPIDER) end-game payload: vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit destroying shadow copies and Windows Recovery, executed within 30 min of mass file rename to .clop/.Cllp/.C_l_0_p and dropping of the trademark 'CIopReadMe.txt' (the 'I' is intentional and is a Cl0p signature) ransom note on >=5 directories. The three-event co-occurrence on a single host is uniquely the Cl0p impact step.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as recoveryDestroyTime values(Processes.process) as recoveryCmd values(Processes.process_name) as recoveryImage from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadows /all*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-CimInstance*Win32_ShadowCopy*") by Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | join type=inner host [ | tstats `summariesonly` count as clopExtFiles min(_time) as firstEnc max(_time) as lastEnc from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("created","renamed") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.clop" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.Cllp" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.C_l_0_p" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.Cl0p") by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as host | where clopExtFiles >= 10 ] | join type=inner host [ | tstats `summariesonly` count as ransomNotes dc(Filesystem.file_path) as noteDirs from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="created" AND Filesystem.file_name IN ("CIopReadMe.txt","ClopReadMe.txt","Cl0pReadMe.txt","README_README.txt","!_README_!.txt","HOW_TO_DECRYPT.txt") by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as host | where noteDirs >= 5 ] | eval enc_to_destroy_min = round(abs(recoveryDestroyTime - firstEnc) / 60, 1) | where enc_to_destroy_min <= 30 | `security_content_ctime(recoveryDestroyTime)` | `security_content_ctime(firstEnc)` | table host user recoveryImage recoveryCmd recoveryDestroyTime clopExtFiles firstEnc lastEnc ransomNotes noteDirs enc_to_destroy_min
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let ClopExt = @"(?i)\.(c_?l_?0_?p|cllp|clop|cl0p)$";
let RansomNotes = dynamic(["CIopReadMe.txt","ClopReadMe.txt","Cl0pReadMe.txt","README_README.txt","!_README_!.txt","HOW_TO_DECRYPT.txt"]);
let RecoveryDestroy = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("shadowcopy delete","shadows /all","delete catalog","recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","Remove-CimInstance Win32_ShadowCopy","Get-WmiObject Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts (legit backup jobs)
    | project RecoveryDestroyTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              RecoveryImage=FileName, RecoveryCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              RecoveryAccount=AccountName, RecoveryParent=InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ClopEncryption = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex ClopExt
    | summarize EncryptedCount=count(),
                FirstEnc=min(Timestamp), LastEnc=max(Timestamp),
                SampleEncFile=any(FolderPath),
                EncProcess=any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                EncCmd=any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName
    | where EncryptedCount >= 10;       // empirical floor — single-digit hits are red herrings
let RansomNoteFanout = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName in~ (RansomNotes)
    | summarize NoteDirs=dcount(FolderPath), FirstNote=min(Timestamp), SampleNoteDir=any(FolderPath)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName
    | where NoteDirs >= 5;              // Cl0p drops the note in every encrypted directory
RecoveryDestroy
| join kind=inner ClopEncryption on DeviceId
| join kind=inner RansomNoteFanout on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', RecoveryDestroyTime, FirstEnc)) <= 30
| project RecoveryDestroyTime, DeviceName, RecoveryAccount,
          RecoveryImage, RecoveryCmd, RecoveryParent,
          EncryptedCount, FirstEnc, LastEnc, SampleEncFile, EncProcess, EncCmd,
          NoteDirs, SampleNoteDir
| order by RecoveryDestroyTime desc
